findings: Completed full body translation of all 17 remaining dashboard pages. All KpiCard titles/descriptions, CardTitle/CardDescription, TabsTrigger labels, table headers, EmptyState titles/descriptions, and form labels now use dict[] references. The ~280 dictionary keys from the prior commit were wired into the pages. TypeScript typecheck passes (confirms key parity). All 25 i18n tests pass. Some dynamic descriptions that interpolate numbers alongside static text still use template literals with dict key fragments, which is the established pattern from the dashboard page.
